blocks.text: Paint the Hub, a community mural-painting activity at the Biz Hub at LIMA Estate in Batangas, enabled the community of locators, employees, students, and local artists to help bring color and creativity to Biz Hub’s shared spaces. In partnership with muralist Nini Andrada Sacro and through her Paint It Forward campaign, together with official paint sponsors Jotun Philippines, Inc., and Atformhaus Studio, the project aims to transform walls, pathways, and other shared areas, into permanent art installations, reflecting the collective identity of the community in the estate.
